items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: I think I mentioned the time he sent me and the Aspiders... he got me the $250... I got along. You know, I played at the Dew Drop at one stretch for two years... that's why I got to know Frank Fairley well

ctx.x: What do you think Frank thought of all this? Frank Panion?

Well, Frank, he would never see. You would talk to Frank in private, I guess he would say something. But most likely he would probably a little bit too drunk to say too much anyway. Yeah. He kept his liquor. Frank Panion, I don't know if we ever told you about this, but Frank had a drink. Anyway, he had to stop for five minutes. He had, oh yeah, he was, well, he's been allowed. He had a bottle somewhere. He had all kind of bottles. He said, I'll talk to him in the jar. He reached and pulled his drop. Check it…
What are some more things about Frank?
